configured.description: Always true for visibility data, which is read from Notra's own database.

from.description: First UTC day of the range.

to.description: Last UTC day of the range.

published.description: Posts published for the project in the range.

cited.description: Of those, the ones an AI answer has cited since.

medianDaysToFirstCitation.description: Median days to the first citation of the cited ones.

impactMinAnswers.description: Answers the targeted prompt needs on each side of the publish time for an impact read.

url.description: The live URL citations are matched against, or null when the post isn't live.

firstCitedDay.description: UTC day an AI answer first listed its URL as a source after publishing, or null.

daysToFirstCitation.description: Whole UTC days from publishing to that first citation.

firstCitedBy.description: Engine of the first answer that cited it.

status.description: `not_enough_data` when the targeted prompt had fewer than `impactMinAnswers` answers on either side, or the other prompts had none; then only the answer counts are set.

windowDays.description: Days compared on each side of the publish time.

answersBefore.description: Answers to the targeted prompt before publishing.

answersAfter.description: Answers to the targeted prompt after publishing.

targetedBefore.description: Visibility rate of the targeted prompt before publishing, from 0 to 1: answers that mentioned the brand or cited its site.

targetedAfter.description: Visibility rate of the targeted prompt after publishing, from 0 to 1.

otherBefore.description: Visibility rate of every other prompt before publishing, from 0 to 1.

otherAfter.description: Visibility rate of every other prompt after publishing, from 0 to 1.

liftPts.description: Change on the targeted prompt minus the change on all other prompts, in percentage points. Positive means the targeted prompt rose more than the rest.

impact.description: How the prompt its GEO brief targeted moved against all other prompts, before vs after publishing. Null when the brief targeted no tracked prompt or the post hasn't been cited.

posts.description: Posts published in the range or first cited in it, newest first. A post belongs to the project through its GEO brief, its Site or its collection, else through its domain.

id.description: Workspace ID. Account API keys can send it, or the slug, as X-Notra-Organization-Id.

slug.description: URL-safe workspace handle, unique across Notra.

logo.description: Workspace logo image URL. Null when none is set.

getGeoContentCitations.description: Content published for the project and whether AI answers cite it: the green dots on the visibility chart.
